title: LINUXDRV-005: If custom property allocation fails after `indigo_aux_attach()` has already succeeded, `aux_attach()` returns `INDIGO_FAILED` without releasing any properties allocated b
summary: LINUXDRV-005: If custom property allocation fails after `indigo_aux_attach()` has already succeeded, `aux_attach()` returns `INDIGO_FAILED` without releasing any properties allocated before the failed allocation and without detaching the base AUX context. Add a single cleanup path that releases partially initialized properties, destroys initialized mutexes, and calls `indigo_aux_detach()`. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
